phase_prompt.summary: A fully operational industrial corridor with glowing glyphs and crystalline conduits.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic, cinematic shot of a vast industrial corridor inspired by ancient Ethiopian and Egyptian aesthetics, with towering basalt pillars etched with hieroglyphs, polished obsidian panels, and a central luminous line of crystalline conduits pulsing with bio‑luminescent light. The walls are covered in woven metal plates patterned with lotus motifs, and subtle mineral mist reflects the glow, creating a grounded, tactile atmosphere of industrial mysticism.
